name: Pseudoephrine
summary: The drug is widely sold as a decongestant and is one isomer of ephedrine. The drug reportedly lacks in recreational effects. It is used in the synthesis of methcathinone and methamphetamine.
advisory: Avoid: If one is prone to or has a pre-exisiting condition relating to the heart.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

warnings.text: Never with an MAOI, including Syrian rue, harmala or ayahuasca. A 19-year-old died of multiple organ failure in January 2023 after taking 24 ephedrine asthma tablets, then drinking a home brew of Syrian rue (harmala) and acacia bark boiled for over an hour and a half. Together they can push blood pressure high enough to cause bleeding in the brain and heart failure.

pharmacology.en: It mainly causes the release of noradrenaline, which narrows blood vessels in the nose and reduces swelling. Its effects on the brain are weaker than those of ephedrine or amphetamine.
pharmacology.zh: 它主要促使正腎上腺素釋放，讓鼻腔血管收縮、減輕腫脹。它對大腦的作用比麻黃鹼或安非他命弱。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它主要促使正肾上腺素释放，让鼻腔血管收缩、减轻肿胀。它对大脑的作用比麻黄碱或安非他命弱。

uses.en: It is widely used as a nasal decongestant for colds and allergies. Because it can be turned into methamphetamine, its sale is restricted in many countries.
uses.zh: 它被廣泛用作感冒和過敏的鼻塞藥。由於它可被用來製造甲基安非他命，許多國家限制它的販售。
uses.zhHans: 它被广泛用作感冒和过敏的鼻塞药。由于它可被用来制造甲基安非他命，许多国家限制它的贩售。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include sleeplessness, restlessness, a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, dry mouth and difficulty passing urine. Rarely it can contribute to stroke or serious heart problems.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括失眠、坐立不安、心跳加快、血壓升高、口乾和排尿困難。少數情況下可能促成中風或嚴重的心臟問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括失眠、坐立不安、心跳加快、血压升高、口干和排尿困难。少数情况下可能促成中风或严重的心脏问题。

fact.en: Pseudoephedrine and ephedrine come from Ephedra, the plant known in Chinese medicine as ma huang, which has been used for thousands of years. Ephedrine was first isolated from it in 1885 by the Japanese chemist Nagai Nagayoshi.
fact.zh: 假麻黃鹼和麻黃鹼都來自麻黃這種植物，它在中醫裡已使用了數千年。麻黃鹼於 1885 年由日本化學家長井長義首次從中分離出來。
fact.zhHans: 假麻黄碱和麻黄碱都来自麻黄这种植物，它在中医里已使用了数千年。麻黄碱于 1885 年由日本化学家长井长义首次从中分离出来。
